# Offline Sigstore fixtures

Generated by `go run scripts/generate-update-fixtures.go` using sigstore-go's virtual CA and Rekor implementation.
Only public certificates, public trust material, signatures and the signed artifact are stored. Generated private
keys are discarded without being written or printed. Tests read static fixtures, so verification does not depend
on a network service or the current wall clock. These keys are unrelated to the production embedded Public Good root.

`official.json` has the exact release workflow identity for v2.0.0 and the GitHub Actions OIDC issuer. The other
fixtures are valid signatures from the same test CA, with a different repository, branch ref, issuer or workflow, to
exercise identity rejection independently of invalid signatures. The test CA issues no SCT, so the full verifier
refuses all of them: `official.json` is the missing-SCT case, and the identity rule is tested on its own. Fixtures use the v0.1 signed-entry-timestamp format; the
library also accepts later Sigstore bundle formats with inclusion proofs.

## Published releases

`release/<tag>/` holds the two public assets of real releases of this repository, downloaded once with
`gh release download <tag> -p checksums.txt -p checksums.txt.sigstore.json`. They verify offline against the embedded
root and are the accepting cases. Tests never download them.
